name: Path tower defense
summary: Place towers beside a fixed enemy path; enemies walk it in waves and leaking enemies cost lives.
core_loop: spend gold on towers → wave walks the path → towers auto-fire → earn gold → next wave
example_prompts: bloons td but the balloons are pizzas
kingdom rush style defense for my school
tower defense where the towers are cats

name: Row-lane plant defense
summary: Place defenders in rows on a lawn; enemies walk along rows toward the house and each defender fights only its row.
core_loop: collect sun → place defender in a row → enemies approach → defenders shoot → survive
rules: defenders cost sun that falls over time
special defenders hit rows or area
example_prompts: plants vs zombies but the plants are school snacks
lane defense game where my cats protect the house
pvz with pirates

name: Maze-building defense
summary: Enemies pathfind across an open field; towers also act as walls, so you build a long maze for them to wander through.
core_loop: place a tower/wall → enemy path recalculates → wave spawns → towers fire as the enemies walk the maze
rules: enemies always take the shortest open path
example_prompts: desktop tower defense but the enemies are pizza rats
maze defense for my phone
build the longest path for goblins

name: Active-tap defense
summary: Towers help, but your taps do the real damage on dangerous enemies; tapping must be fast to protect the core.
core_loop: enemies advance → tap them to damage → towers help → gold from kills → buy towers
rules: some enemies only die to taps
example_prompts: tap to defend a cake from ants
clicker defense with a dragon core
tap heroes defend a castle

name: Draw the defense
summary: Draw barrier lines with ink that last a few seconds; enemies must go around, and drawn lines can funnel them into hazards.
core_loop: draw a barrier line → enemies redirect → traps hit them → ink refills → next wave
rules: lines vanish after a few seconds
example_prompts: draw lines to keep ants away from my picnic
ink barriers to protect a wizard tower
draw to funnel zombies into traps

name: Merge-tower defense
summary: Spawn random towers on a small grid; merge two of the same level into one stronger tower while waves approach.
core_loop: spawn tower → merge two same → tower levels up → wave attacks → repeat
example_prompts: merge defense game with cats in a castle
random dice style merge towers
merge cannons to beat a boss

name: One-tower upgrade tree
summary: Defend with one big tower you keep upgrading down a branching tree; choices change how it fights.
core_loop: wave attacks → earn gold → pick an upgrade branch → tower changes → next wave
example_prompts: defend a lighthouse with one tower and choose upgrades
one big tower upgrade tree like a roguelike
defend the school with a single cannon

name: Reverse tower defense
summary: You send creeps down the path against defenses; choose the creep mix that gets the most through.
core_loop: see towers → choose creep types → send wave → watch → spend earnings → repeat
rules: creeps differ in speed, armor and range
example_prompts: send zombies against a pizza defender
reverse tower defense where i'm the monster
send ants through a picnic defense

name: Trap defense
summary: Place traps (spike, freeze, push) on tiles of the path instead of turrets; combos stall and then finish enemies.
core_loop: place trap on path → enemies trigger it → trap recharges → combos
rules: each trap fires once then recharges
example_prompts: home alone traps against burglars
orcs must die style trap placement
set traps for goblins in my attic

name: Armor-type popping
summary: Enemies come in layers with immunities (lead, camo, ice); you must match tower damage type to the layer.
core_loop: wave arrives with immunities → buy matching tower → pop layer by layer → leaks cost lives
rules: some enemies need certain damage types
example_prompts: bloons td but the balloons have armor
match the tower to the balloon layer
pop balloons with different darts

name: 360-degree core defense
summary: Defend a central core with rotating turret arcs against enemies from all directions.
core_loop: rotate turret → fire arcs → enemies hit from the edge → upgrade → boss
example_prompts: dome keeper but cute
defend a core from all sides with a rotating cannon
360 defense game with dragons

name: Draft-and-keep defense
summary: Each round place five random towers; keep only one and turn the rest into rocks that shape the maze.
core_loop: place five random towers → choose one to keep → others become walls → wave runs
rules: quality of towers improves with combos
discarded ones still act as walls
example_prompts: gem td with cats and wizards
keep one of five random towers each round
roguelike tower draft

name: Air defense
summary: Flying enemies ignore the path and dive at the base; deploy anti-air towers with arcs and ammunition.
core_loop: flyers appear → tap tower or place AA → intercept → ammo management → next wave
example_prompts: bloons style anti-air
missile command with pigeons
defend the school roof from drones

name: Chokepoint line
summary: Deploy defenders into a chokepoint; positioning melee, ranged and support units correctly holds back a huge horde.
core_loop: place defenders at choke → horde arrives → melee holds → ranged hit → support heals
example_prompts: helm's deep style choke point for cats
hold the bridge against skeletons
300 chokepoint with hamsters

name: Ability-only defense
summary: Defenders are fixed; your only inputs are limited-use abilities (freeze, nuke, heal) fired at the right moment.
core_loop: watch wave → tap ability → ability cooldown → time the next one → survive
example_prompts: use only freeze and nuke to survive a zombie night
defense game where abilities are my only control
time your spells against a dragon horde

name: Farm crop defense
summary: Pests raid your crops; place scarecrows, fences and dogs, and harvest before they eat everything.
core_loop: pests arrive from edges → place scarecrow or fence → harvest crops → pests eat unprotected
example_prompts: farm defense against hungry crows
plants vs zombies on a farm for my phone
scarecrows against raccoons

name: Sandcastle tide
summary: Build sand walls to hold back incoming waves that erode and wash away; reinforce the weakest section.
core_loop: tide rises → wall HP drops → tap to rebuild or reinforce → keep the castle dry
rules: waves come on a visible schedule
example_prompts: sandcastle defense versus the tide
build up walls against waves
defend the beach castle with my cat

name: Spawner demolition
summary: Defend while pushing out to destroy enemy spawn gates, since destroying them ends the waves early.
core_loop: defend lane → spend gold to extend line → attack spawn gate → gate falls → waves end
example_prompts: tower defense where i have to destroy the spawn caves
defend and push forward against goblin gates
take out the dragon eggs while defending

name: Group base defense
summary: A base shared by a Group is attacked in waves over the week; each member places one defender per day.
core_loop: each member places a defender → wave attacks overnight → damage report → repair → repeat
rules: each member has one action per day
social_hooks: the Group builds a base together
example_prompts: our group chat defends a castle
everyone places one defender a day
co-op tower defense with my class

name: Priority targeting
summary: Towers fire at the front enemy by default; you tap to focus on shielded, healing or buffing enemies first.
core_loop: enemies arrive in a mixed group → tap to focus the key enemy → kill it → rest becomes easy
example_prompts: arknights style focus fire for cats
kill the healer first game
priority target defense against skeletons

name: Rhythm towers
summary: Towers fire only on the beat; you tap to time boosts, and enemies march in sync with the music.
core_loop: enemies march on beat → tap on beat to boost towers → perfect beats chain → waves
example_prompts: rhythm tower defense like necrodancer
towers that fire on the beat to a pop song
beat-synced defense against ghosts

name: Barricade the door
summary: Enemies bash at doors and windows; tap to nail boards back before each barricade breaks.
core_loop: enemies hit a barricade → HP drops → tap to repair → boards run out → hold until dawn
rules: each opening has its own HP
boards are limited and found over time
example_prompts: hold the door against zombies in my school
barricade the windows against a monster night
left 4 dead safe room on my phone

name: Hero-led defense
summary: One controllable hero walks the field to fight and rally spawned minions; positioning the hero decides which front holds.
core_loop: tap to move hero → hero fights → rally point for minions → hero abilities → next wave
example_prompts: kingdom rush heroes with a cat paladin
defend with one hero and barracks
hero tower defense in a haunted castle

name: Angle-and-power cannon
summary: Aim a fortress cannon by angle and power at advancing enemies; arcs and wind decide hits.
core_loop: drag to set angle and power → release → shot arcs → hit or miss → enemies advance
example_prompts: angry birds style cannon defense of a pizza fortress
aim the cannon to stop viking boats
artillery defense against dragons

name: Shield deflection
summary: Rotate a shield arc around a core to deflect incoming projectiles; some bounce back to hit enemies.
core_loop: rotate shield → projectile hits shield → deflects → bounces damage enemy → survive
rules: larger waves fire from multiple sides
example_prompts: dome shield deflect lasers from aliens
rotating shield game
defend a core with a paddle shield

name: Power-grid turrets
summary: Turrets need power; place generators and cables to keep turrets running while enemies approach.
core_loop: place generator → connect cables → turrets draw power → enemies attack lines → reroute
example_prompts: mindustry for phone
keep your lasers powered against goblins
power grid defense with hamster engineers

name: Convert-and-defend
summary: Defeated enemies can be tamed into your defenders when you use a charm; build an army from the wave's survivors.
core_loop: enemy weakened → tap charm → it joins defense → next wave with new allies
rules: only weakened enemies can be charmed
example_prompts: pikmin tower defense
tame the zombies to defend my house
charm monsters and let them fight for me

name: Splitting swarm
summary: Enemies split into smaller ones when hit; choose between area damage towers and focused ones to avoid being swamped.
core_loop: big slimes advance → hit splits them → area damage clears splits → spacing matters
rules: each hit splits an enemy into two smaller ones
example_prompts: slime defense where hits split them
tower defense with splitting enemies
clear slimes before they swarm

name: Tower cards
summary: Each turn draw a hand of tower cards; place the cards you can afford, knowing the deck cycles.
core_loop: draw hand → pick tower cards → place → wave → discard cycles
example_prompts: monster train style tower cards for a school
deck of towers that cycles
tower defense card game with cats

name: Reposition defense
summary: Few tower slots exist; you can sell and reposition towers between waves, trading refund loss for better coverage.
core_loop: see next wave preview → rearrange towers → wave runs → earn gold
example_prompts: tower defense where i get a preview of each wave and rearrange
chess defense with moving cats
reposition my archers between waves

name: Wall archers
summary: Archers stand on a wall and loose arrows automatically; upgrade wall height, archers and special arrows while attackers climb.
core_loop: gather coins → upgrade wall or archers → attackers hit the wall → wall HP drops → next wave
example_prompts: castle wall defense with cat archers
stick war defense on my phone
keep the wall up against dragons

name: Terrain shaping
summary: Dig channels, raise walls or flood sections to reroute and slow enemies before they reach the base.
core_loop: tap to dig or raise tiles → enemies re-path → floods delay them → wave passes
example_prompts: dig trenches to protect a sandcastle
flood the path to stop invaders
shape terrain to defend the village

name: Day-night defense
summary: By day, gather and build; at night, enemies attack. The cycle repeats with escalating nights.
core_loop: day: gather and build → night: enemies attack → dawn: repair → repeat
example_prompts: kingdom two crowns style day night defense for cats
build all day and survive the night
they are billions on a phone

name: Chain-reaction barrels
summary: Place explosive barrels and traps along the path; one trigger sets a chain that clears the horde.
core_loop: place barrels → enemies approach → tap to detonate at the right time → chain clears
rules: detonate before they reach the base
example_prompts: set barrels along the road and blow up the zombies
chain reaction defense with fireworks
crush the castle but defending

name: Ammo logistics defense
summary: Turrets run out of ammo; drag ammo crates to the right ones in time while enemies keep coming.
core_loop: turrets fire and drain → drag crate to refill → prioritize busiest turrets
rules: each turret has a different fire rate
example_prompts: feed cannons while goblins attack
ammo resupply defense in a space station
resupply the archers under attack
